race.comment: CHICAGO KING (2) returned to the winners' stall over this track and trip last time out and will have derived a stack of confidence from that victory. Winning rider Apel sticks and again gets the benefit of her 2kg claim. Sure to be right there when the judge calls a halt. ARGENTUM ROCK (12) doesn't win out of turn but has hit the top-four in all eight starts this campaign and is usually about the money. In the mix. TILL DUSK (9) will be ready to peak now third run back and gets in light with the claim. Top-three credentials. DUKE OF CAMDEN (3) best of the rest out of the champion Gollan yard.
